snippet.title: Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition - Most Wanted Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Ghost of Yōtei Most Wanted is a brand-new combat survival mode designed to gauge your strength and test your resilience. Fight off waves of enemies and take on challenging new boss encounters. All sorts of new incentives await; earn everything from new weapons and cosmetics to playable characters you can unlock.
 
Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition is available to purchase today*.
Echoes of Sekigahara and Most Wanted available October 1, 2026**†. 
 
Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/games/ghost-of-yotei/ 
 
*Digital version only. Physical version available October 1, 2026
**Available via patch v2.0 or later. Internet connection and account for PlayStation® required to download. 
†Available October 2 in some territories including Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.

#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #ghostofyotei 

Rated Mature
